paragraphs.text: Team Fortress 2 is a class-based first-person shooter developed by Valve Corporation and available on Windows, macOS, Linux, Xbox 360, and PlayStation 3. In the game, players select one of nine characters, each with unique weapons and attributes, and fight an opposing team of players in one of a variety of game modes. Additionally, players are able to customize their characters with a wide variety of items, both functional and purely cosmetic.

In a collaboration with Magic: The Gathering , those who purchased Duels of the Planeswalkers 2012 on Steam before its release on June 15, 2011 would receive two in-game cosmetics for Team Fortress 2 : the "Planeswalker Goggles" (based on Chandra 's goggles) for the scout and the "Planeswalker Helm" (based on Garruk 's helmet) for the medic.

Though the opportunity to obtain these two items through preordering Duels of the Planeswalkers 2012 has long since passed, these items can still be obtained either by crafting them in-game or by trading with other players. Versions of these items that were obtained by preordering have a "Genuine" designator applied to them so that they can be distinguished from crafted versions.
